verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents pulling data out through its public APIs to sync to other systems and for analysis, and says its data can be read headlessly via API and MCP. Reads are paginated JSON, and an importable API spec is offered. There is no documented one-click or bulk full-account export, no CSV or other open-format export, and nothing on completeness or offboarding. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account export, open-format file exports (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types (templates, flows, events), offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.
